data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Eche', meaning 'rejoice' or 'blessing' and 'elle', meaning 'God'. This name signifies the grace and blessings of God. The name Eachelle carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eachelle usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
